name: word-relay
title: Word relay
description: Exchanges phrases, words or letters inside a stable wrapping footprint, with interruptible motion and explicit navigation.

props.name: index
props.description: A controlled index. Omit for the internal timer.

props.name: auto
props.description: Opt in to automatic changes and provide a nearby pause control.

props.name: loop
props.description: When false, automatic and manual navigation stop at the first/last phrase.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Milliseconds between units, compressed to a maximum 500ms stagger window.

props.name: controlsRef
props.description: Keeps the normal ref pointing to the span; navigation has its own optional ref.
